description: Ex-INAS 300 White Tigers, given to IIT Madras Aerospace dept late 1980s, kept wings-folded inside a workshop with IIT logo. Source WoI 2008.
HAL-built Prentice (ID plate dated 22 Aug 1951), derelict in shrubbery, no engine or undercarriage, no serial. Source WoI (2001 discovery).
Derelict Canadian-built Harvard with traces of RAF/RIAF roundels at a government establishment in Chennai (WoI files it under IIT); BR identifies HT-304, derelict, no engine. Source WoI, BR.
